info.title: Moodle LMS RESTful API
info.summary: RESTful API specification for Moodle LMS with webhooks
info.description:
RESTful API specification for Moodle LMS.

## API Endpoints
This uses Moodle's **actual RESTful endpoint**:
`/webservice/restful/server.php/{function_name}`

**Authentication:** Send the token in the **Authorization** header: `Authorization: Bearer <your_wstoken>`.

Example:
```
Authorization: Bearer your_wstoken_here
Content-Type: application/json

{"param1": "value1"}
```

## Webhooks – Publish Events API (Medad Fusion)
Moodle publishes events to **POST /events/publish**. Use **api-key** and **tenant** headers. Body: array of event objects.

Event types:

- **lms_user_graded** - Event triggered after teacher edits manual grade or

Generated from Moodle 4.5.12+ (Build: 20260714)

parameters.name: options

schema.description:
Option names:
* withcapability (string) return only users with this capability. This option requires 'moodle/role:review' on the course context.
* groupid (integer) return only users in this group id. If the course has groups enabled and this param
isn't defined, returns all the viewable users.
This option requires 'moodle/site:accessallgroups' on the course context if the
user doesn't belong to the group.
* onlyactive (integer) return only users with active enrolments and matching time restrictions.
This option requires 'moodle/course:enrolreview' on the course context.
Please note that this option can't
be used together with onlysuspended (only one can be active).
* onlysuspended (integer) return only suspended users. This option requires
'moodle/course:enrolreview' on the course context. Please note that this option can't
be used together with onlyactive (only one can be active).
* userfields ('string, string, ...') return only the values of these user fields.
* limitfrom (integer) sql limit from.
* limitnumber (integer) maximum number of returned users.
* sortby (string) sort by id, firstname or lastname. For ordering like the site does, use siteorder.
* sortdirection (string) ASC or DESC

parameters.name: criteria

schema.description:
the key/value pairs to be considered in user search. Values can not be empty.
Specify different keys only once (fullname => 'user1', auth => 'manual', ...) -
key occurences are forbidden.
The search is executed with AND operator on the criterias. Invalid criterias (keys) are ignored,
the search is still executed on the valid criterias.
You can search without criteria, but the function is not designed for it.
It could very slow or timeout. The function is designed to search some specific users.

key.description:
the user column to search, expected keys (value format) are:
"id" (int) matching user id,
"lastname" (string) user last name (Note: you can use % for searching but it may be considerably slower!),
"firstname" (string) user first name (Note: you can use % for searching but it may be considerably slower!),
"idnumber" (string) matching user idnumber,
"username" (string) matching user username,
"email" (string) user email (Note: you can use % for searching but it may be considerably slower!),
"auth" (string) matching user auth plugin

post.summary: Event triggered after teacher edits manual grade or
post.description:
**Publish Events API** (Medad Fusion)

Moodle publishes events to: **POST /events/publish**

- **Authentication:** API key sent in the **api-key** header (per port).
- **Required header:** **tenant** – tenant identifier for your product/port.
- **Content-Type:** application/json
- **Request body:** Array of event objects (see schema). Each event has: `id`, `payload`, `eventType`, `timestamp` (optional), `idempotencyId` (optional).


Event triggered after teacher edits manual grade or
overrides activity/aggregated grade.
Note: use grade_grades_history table if you need to know
the history of grades.

**Moodle Event Class:** `\core\event\user_graded`

application/json.description: Array of event objects. eventType for this webhook: `lms_user_graded`.

401.description: Invalid API key or missing api-key header

wsToken.description: API token. Send in Authorization header: Authorization: Bearer <your_wstoken>

webhookAuth.description: Legacy (deprecated). Use webhookApiKey for Publish Events API.

webhookApiKey.name: api-key
webhookApiKey.description: API key for Publish Events API (per port). Sent in the api-key header.

ActivityGradeItem.description: Grade data for a single activity or quiz question.

GradeCategoryNode.description: Grade category node with total grade and nested children.

grade.description: Student total grade in this category

UserGradedPayload.description: Payload for lms_user_graded event. Contains common grade data at root level and activity-specific data under quiz/assignment key.

coursetotalgrade.description: Course total grade for the student (e.g. 85.00)

categorygradename.description: Category name (only if activity is under a subcategory)

categorygrade.description: Category total grade (only if activity is under a subcategory)

gradeCategoryStructure.description: Branch of the grade category tree that the activity belongs to, with each category's grade

quiz.description: Quiz grade data with per-question breakdown (present when grading a quiz)

assignment.description: Assignment grade data (present when grading an assignment)

PublishEventItem.description: Single event in the Publish Events API (Medad Fusion). For lms_user_graded, payload is UserGradedPayload.

id.description: Unique event ID from your system

payload.description: Event-specific data object. For lms_user_graded: UserGradedPayload with quiz/assignment data.

timestamp.description: (Optional) Event time in ISO 8601 format, e.g. YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm:ssZ

PublishEventsRequest.description: Request body for POST /events/publish. Send an array of event objects.

WebhookPayload.description: Legacy webhook payload (deprecated). Use Publish Events API format (PublishEventsRequest) instead.

UsergradedMessage.description: Content of the message field for lms_user_graded events (dynamically generated from observer code)

eventid.description: Unique identifier for this event instance
